intro.title: BUILD
intro.paragraph: Samuel works with young Africans who are done waiting for permission to build wealth. Through consulting, community, and content — he helps ambitious people turn the businesses they have into the businesses they actually want.

about.heading: He doesn't just market businesses. He builds growth machines.
paragraphs: Samuel is a Doctor of Pharmacy who walked away from the expected path to build. While still at KNUST, he founded Outbrooks Technology Limited and grew a campus entrepreneurship initiative into Sigmart YAE, a pan African network that has reached thousands of young entrepreneurs.

Today he runs Outbrooks Consult, a high growth digital marketing agency that builds the marketing systems that help businesses and organizations scale. Beyond the agency, he speaks on stages across Africa and beyond, mentors young builders, and is writing The Economy of the Young African Mind.

offers.title: The Growth Engine
offers.description:
Most marketing is random posts and hope. Samuel builds a complete growth engine around your business, whatever stage you're at.

It starts with a full audit of where you are. Then we build the systems your business needs to scale, which may include:
features: Clarity: tracking that shows exactly what's working.
Visibility: content and search presence that put you in front of the right people.
Conversion: funnels and sales systems that turn attention into revenue.
Acceleration: paid advertising to scale what's already working.
Loyalty: referral and retention systems that multiply your customers.
Handover: documented systems and a team that knows how to run them.
offers.closing: Every business is different, so the mix is too. Work with us however suits you: done for you, done with you, or training your team. Engagements range from a single strategy session to a long term growth partnership.

offers.title: Speaking Engagements
offers.description: Samuel has taken the stage at universities, conferences, faith communities and global organizations, and has convened summits and business fairs of his own. Every talk leaves your audience thinking differently and knowing exactly what to do next.
